body: As observed in https://calkit.io/petebachant/clima-perf, when `NEW_T_END` is used, it can lead to misleading benchmark. This is because the diagnostics are triggered which lead to the SYPD being off due to the diagnostics initializing for the first time. This PR removes the benchmark config from being updated by `.buildkite/nightly/set_t_end.sh`.
title: Keep NEW_T_END from changing the he16 benchmark t_end
